description: Elastic constants: DFT 0K clamped-ion, MLIP 300K unit cell, MLIP 300K 2x2x1 SC, MLIP 600K snapshot (paper)

dft_0K_clamped_ion._version: v1 (legacy, ordered-Li 0K, energy-curvature C_ii + cubic-symmetry C12 from BM K)
dft_0K_clamped_ion.method: QE finite strain ±0.005, 6 patterns x pos/neg = 12 SCF, kbar->GPa, QE sign flip
dft_0K_clamped_ion.notes: Ordered Li -> cooperative shear -> C44 overestimated. Reference only, NOT for paper. For paper-quality finite-T values, see mlip_600K_snapshot (also v1 lineage) or the new dft_0K_clamped_ion_stress_strain_full_Cij (v3 lineage, annealed Li, full 6×6 Cij).

dft_0K_clamped_ion_stress_strain_full_Ci.method: QE finite strain ±0.005, 12 SCF (6 Voigt patterns × ±h), full 6×6 Cij extracted from stress tensor σ = -(1/V) ∂E/∂ε with QE sign flip. Off-diagonal C12/C13/C23 measured directly via the column-by-column approach (one strain SCF gives one Cij column). No external bulk modulus K needed.
dft_0K_clamped_ion_stress_strain_full_Ci.advantage_over_energy_method: Energy curvature only recovers diagonal Voigt C_ii. Stress-strain gives the full 6×6 matrix in the same 12 SCFs, including the off-diagonal cross-coupling, with a built-in cross-check (Cij = Cji symmetry).
dft_0K_clamped_ion_stress_strain_full_Ci._comp1_v3_redo_note: Original comp1_v3 entry (E_VRH=55.64 at v2 cell V≈979 Å³) was retracted 2026-06-03. Replaced 2026-06-03 with the entry below, computed at the true BM-EOS V0 (1016.62 Å³, a=10.055 Å, V0_relax converged 18 BFGS steps, fmax<1e-4) — paper-grade. Archive of v2-cell SCFs on container: /home/ubuntu/work/runs/comp1_v3/archive_v2_post/.

vs_modelc_v3_same_method_at_true_V0.headline: At DFT 0K, B/G/E are essentially identical (±2%) between LPSCl and LPSCl1.6 — DFT misses the experimentally observed LPSCl1.6 stiffening. Anisotropy difference is the only Cij-level fingerprint of vacancy/disorder. Finite-T effects (phonon anharmonic stiffening, Li dynamic redistribution) need to explain the experimental Young's modulus delta.

vs_BM_EOS_K.note: K_VRH (clamped-ion, harmonic only) > B0_BM (full hydrostatic E(V)). Typical ratio 1.5-2× for soft Cl-rich argyrodites. Both methods reach physically meaningful but distinct quantities — report both.

vs_modelc_v1_DFT_clamped_ion.interpretation: C11/K consistent with modelc v1 → same composition confirmed. C44/G/E reduced by ~30-50% → modelC_v3 likely captures Li-disorder basin (no longer ordered 0K minimum). C44=14.4 is very close to modelc_v2_mlip_600K C44=12.9, supporting interpretation that v3 represents the thermally-accessible Li configuration ensemble.

vs_modelc_v2_mlip_600K.C44_match_GPa: 14.4 (DFT v3) vs 12.9 (MLIP 600K) → 12% delta, within MLIP-DFT typical agreement
vs_modelc_v2_mlip_600K.K_match_GPa: 44.47 (DFT v3) vs 23.4 (MLIP 600K) → 90% delta — MLIP underestimates bulk modulus; expected discrepancy at finite-T MD-quenched configurations

dft_0K_relaxed_ion_stress_strain_full_Ci.method: Same 12 strain SCFs (±0.005, 6 Voigt) but with atoms ALLOWED TO RELAX at each fixed strained cell (calculation='relax', cell_dofree='none' implicit, BFGS conv_thr 1e-4 Ry/au). Stress measured AT the relaxed atomic positions → includes ionic Born screening. Compared to clamped-ion which freezes atoms at V0 positions.
dft_0K_relaxed_ion_stress_strain_full_Ci.vacancy_paradox_role: Clamped-ion DFT systematically over-estimates argyrodite elastic moduli (E_VRH 52.31 GPa for LPSCl vs experiment ~23 GPa, ~2.3× too stiff). Allowing ion relaxation recovers experimentally consistent values. This is the physics behind why the 'clamped-ion vacancy paradox' (LPSCl ≈ LPSCl1.6 elastically at static 0K) needs finite-T or relaxed-ion to resolve.

results.k_mesh: 4x4x4 (k×L=40) — PAPER-GRADE, supersedes earlier k221 run (values within ~1%, geometry RMS 0.003 Å)
results.vs_experiment: E_VRH = 22.06 GPa matches literature LPSCl (~23 GPa, e.g. He et al.). G_VRH = 8.13 matches ~8 GPa expt. B_VRH = 25.51 close to BM-EOS B0 = 26.23 GPa (Δ3%) — internal cross-check.
results.vs_k221_prior: Earlier k221 relaxed-ion gave E_VRH 22.33 / B 25.18 / G 8.26; k444 gives 22.06 / 25.51 / 8.13 — within ~1%, confirming elastic is geometry-driven (RMS 0.003 Å) and k444-robust here.

vs_clamped_ion.headline: Clamped-ion DFT massively over-estimates elastic moduli. Ion relaxation under strain recovers experimentally consistent values. Argyrodite Li sublattice softness is the dominant ion-screening contribution.

results.lineage: modelc V0_relax at BM-EOS V0=1216.44 Å³ → 12 strain relax SCFs (BFGS atom-only, fixed strained cell)

vs_comp1_v3_relaxed.headline: ★ VACANCY PARADOX RESOLVED ★ — LPSCl1.6 is 24% stiffer than LPSCl at DFT 0K relaxed-ion, MATCHING experimental trend. Stiffening is primarily SHEAR (G_VRH +28%) while bulk is slightly soft (-7%). The shear-dominant stiffening + anisotropy increase reflects vacancy + 4d-Cl anti-site lock-in of certain shear configurations.

mlip_600K_snapshot_v3._version: v3 (comp1_v3 + modelC_v3 — BOTH annealed Li, DFT-relaxed V0 starting structures, SAME UMA + SAME script → directly comparable)
mlip_600K_snapshot_v3._purpose: MLIP 600K snapshot elastic for the Paper#1 pair. comp1_v3 (LPSCl) added 2026-06-08 (v100 PID 1851258, runtime 46.7 min); modelC_v3 (LPSCl1.6) from 2026-06-02. Identical method/params → the comp1-vs-modelc 600K comparison is method-clean (UMA-vs-UMA). Do NOT cross-compare absolute magnitude with the DFT-0K rows (UMA≠QE absolute scale); only within-method comparisons are valid.
mlip_600K_snapshot_v3.method: UMA-s-1p1 (task=omat) Langevin 600 K, equilib 10 ps + prod 20 ps, 5 snapshots, FIRE quench (fmax 0.01), per-strain FIRE RELAXED-ION Cij (fmax 0.05) full 6×6, no QE sign flip (FAIRChem returns physical-convention stress).
mlip_600K_snapshot_v3._USAGE_2026_06_08: DEMOTED to SUPPORTING / SI-only — do NOT lead a talk or the paper main figure with the 600K row. Decision (user, 2026-06-08): the core mechanical story is fully carried by the DFT 0K clamped-vs-relaxed-ion pair (same QE footing, attack-proof). The 600K MLIP row adds a 'second re-flip' but requires a cross-method (UMA≠QE absolute scale) asterisk — e.g. 600K E=59.7 > 0K-clamped E=52.3 looks unphysical to a reader and the disclaimer weakens the slide. Keep the computed data here for completeness / reviewer 'what about finite-T?' rebuttal, but HEADLINE = 2-regime DFT (clamped identical → relaxed-ion inverts). The relaxed-ion inversion IS the disorder-jamming evidence on its own.

_three_regime_synthesis.headline: modelc's compositional disorder PRE-JAMS (already at 0K) the soft collective Li-sublattice shear mode that comp1 only loses upon heating. → the relaxed-ion 0K inversion (comp1<modelc) DISAPPEARS/RE-FLIPS at 600K (comp1>modelc). [SUPPORTING — see _USAGE_2026_06_08; lead with the 2-regime DFT story, not this.]
_three_regime_synthesis.clamped_0K_DFT: comp1 ≈ modelc (E≈52.3, G≈20.1, identical) — frozen-ion = pure PS4 framework bonding stiffness, which Cl-enrichment+vacancy leaves UNCHANGED.
_three_regime_synthesis.relaxed_ion_0K_DFT: comp1 (E=22.06, G=8.13) < modelc (E=27.66, G≈10) — INVERSION. comp1's fully ordered Li sublattice keeps a soft collective shear mode alive (Born screening collapses G); modelc's Cl-excess + Li-vacancy disorder jams that mode → stiffer.
_three_regime_synthesis.mlip_600K_UMA: comp1 (E=59.71, G=24.60) > modelc (E=52.72, G=21.85) — inversion GONE. Thermal motion disorders comp1's Li sublattice too, jamming its soft mode (G 8.1→24.6, ~3×); modelc was already jammed so rises less; comp1 ends slightly stiffer (no permanent vacancies as residual soft spots).
_three_regime_synthesis.operating_T_takeaway: At device temperature both are jammed → PS4 framework dominates → similar stiffness; modelc marginally softer due to permanent Li-vacancy soft spots. Conductivity gain (modelc 2.9–3.5× faster Li) does NOT come at a mechanical-rigidity cost at operating T.
_three_regime_synthesis.cross_method_caveat: UMA-600K vs DFT-0K absolute magnitudes are NOT comparable (different reference). E.g. comp1 600K E=59.7 > clamped-0K E=52.3 is a UMA-vs-QE scale artifact, not real thermal stiffening. Compare ONLY within method.
